newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stena Line to reorganise Channel routes.
newsitem.headline: Stena Line to reorganise Channel routes.

text.p: Swedish ferry operator Stena Line said on Friday it would reorganise its ferry crossings over the western part of the English Channel.
The company said in a statement it would close its line between Southampton and Cherbourg in connection with the expiry of the lease on the Stena Normandy ferry.
"Instead, Stena Line will open a new link between Portsmouth and Cherbourg. The new line will be operated with a high-speed ferry," Stena Line said.
It said the reason for the change was a fall in passenger volumes, adding it believed the new high-speed ferry would lead to increased volume and profitability on the line.
Last week Stena Line and the British P&O Ferries announced they would merge their ferry operations on the Dover-Calais route to meet intense price competition from the Eurotunnel.
